Support

Last updated: November 1, 2026

Contact Ohana Labs

For 1on1 support, email ohana.ai.apps@gmail.com. Include the game name, device model, operating-system version, app version and a short description. Screenshots are optional; remove identifying information. Never send passwords or payment details. For a child, a parent or guardian should send the request.

Play, settings and sessions

Choose a game, then two players or a computer opponent. Games with variants offer options before the countdown. The question-mark button explains each game. In turn-based two-player games, the header rotation control changes whether the view turns between players.

Sessions save scores and opening order on this device, not unfinished boards. Continue resumes a rivalry; New session starts another after confirmation. Clearing storage or deleting the app can erase scores. Settings contains sound, vibration, language, these documents and software notices.

Privacy and advertising questions

All games work offline without an account. Google test-ad services in development builds may use network and technical information after the legal step. Live ads are currently disabled. Read the Privacy Policy for local data, Google, public pages, support retention and your rights. Report unsuitable ad content to ohana.ai.apps@gmail.com.
